title: IVG Intense Salts Grape Ice 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Grape Ice combines the bold sweetness of juicy Grapes with a clean, frosty Ice layer. The result is a flavour that balances fruity richness with a refreshing chill. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt provides consistent flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Grape Ice is best suited to mouth-to-lung (MTL) pod kits, starter devices, and vape pens. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Grape Ice offers a straightforward fruit-and-ice combination for sweet-tooth vapers.
